annotations.title: Screen Global Corporate KYB, GLEIF LEI & OFAC/UN Sanctions

description: Screen corporate legal entities and individuals against the official GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) registry, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU consolidated sanctions lists, and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) databases.

entities.description: Organization names or individual full names to screen for KYB/AML compliance.

includeGleifLei.description: Whether to resolve official GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) registration records.

includeSanctionsMatch.description: Whether to check OFAC, UN, EU, and PEP sanctions watchlists.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of KYB and sanctions screening records to return.

name: screen_global_sanctions_and_kyb
